candidates: In `updateArgs` and any similar function that syncs a Vue `reactive()` object to a new state (e.g., in `code/renderers/vue3/src/render.ts`), do not add an early return when the incoming state object is empty. The deletion loop — which removes keys from the reactive object that are absent in the new state — must always run unconditionally; skipping it when `nextArgs` is `{}` leaves stale keys alive in Vue decorators, so resetting args or globals back to an empty state has no effect.

In Vue 3 template strings (both in story/decorator files and in documentation snippets under `docs/_snippets/`), never use mustache interpolation (`{{ }}`) inside HTML attribute bindings. Attribute bindings must use `v-bind` / colon shorthand with a plain JavaScript expression (e.g., `:lang="globals?.locale || 'en'"`). The mixed syntax `:attr={{expr}}` is invalid Vue template syntax and will not render correctly.
